paths.title: Cunning Prevaricator
paths.description: Weave lies so convincing that your friends vanish from the enemy's sight. An action point cloaks you and a nearby ally in invisibility, while your Bardic Virtue can set up an ally to strike with combat advantage. Your majestic word can hide a bloodied friend as it heals, and your spells blur foes' vision, cloak allies in glittering light, and send a miss slipping onto a different target. You protect through misdirection more than armor.

paths.title: Daring Blade
paths.requirements: Skald build or any martial class
paths.description: Duel with a showman's nerve, trusting Charisma to drive your martial weapon attacks and turning your flair into a challenge your enemies cannot ignore. An action point lets you mark every enemy that can see you and gain temporary hit points instead of attacking again. Later, a quick Bluff earns combat advantage as a minor action. Your powers dazzle foes into exposing themselves, speed you out of danger while inspiring allies, and spin you through the air to slide an enemy toward another fighter.

paths.title: Grave Caller
paths.description: Single out a foe with a deathmark and sing it toward the grave. Your encounter attacks still sting when they miss a marked creature, and at higher levels you roll twice for every encounter or daily attack against it. Spending an action point adds a heavy bonus to your damage for the turn. Haunting visions help allies strike your target more accurately, whispers hide you from your quarry, and your fatal daily song leaves lingering ongoing damage that is hard to shake off.

paths.title: Half-Elf Emissary
paths.description: Speak for the whole party and stand out where the odds look worst. Your gift for group diplomacy grows stronger and spreads to skills your allies share with you, and an action point lets you shelter nearby friends while recovering your racial dilettante power. Healing grows as more enemies crowd around a wounded ally. Your powers count heads on the battlefield, turning numbers into attack bonuses, saving throws and defenses for the allies who stay close.

paths.title: Karmic Shaper
paths.description: Bend fate itself so that harm returns to its source. Your action point lets you reroll a d20, and each Virtue of Prescience can protect an ally, heal one who is hit anyway, or let a friend lash out at the attacker. Your spells make enemies pay for hurting someone, trade a missing ally's bad roll for one of your own, and finally treat every attack your target makes as the worst possible roll.

paths.title: Life Singer
paths.description: Resolve conflicts without bloodshed, calming enemies and lifting your companions through crises that swords would only worsen. Allies near you gain a bonus to skill and ability checks, and each ally who spends an action point on a non-attack action gains temporary hit points. Rerolls help your Will attacks land, and your songs daze and weaken foes, grant the party extra non-damaging actions, or lull a cluster of enemies to sleep while friends catch their breath.

paths.title: Master Skald
paths.description: Turn the skald's aura into a lifeline your whole party can lean on. When an ally within it falls, you can answer with the aura's healing, and an action point can hand a nearby friend a free standard action. Your healing grows stronger at higher levels. You punish enemies with an inspiring basic attack that restores nearby allies, offer words that make a skill check succeed, and urge your companions toward a march where every attack roll can be made twice.

paths.title: Summer Rhymer
paths.description: Carry the sunlit magic of the Feywild into combat and let your music bend the field around you. An action point lets you teleport yourself or a neighbor, and Charisma further enriches every bard healing power you use. When a missed attack triggers your Virtue of Cunning, you gain a bonus against that enemy. Your songs cloud enemies' senses while granting allies concealment, open spiral paths of teleportation, and surround the party with a resilient zone.
